summary: Retest of BUG FIX 1 (welcome toast survives navigation, single app-wide Toaster) and BUG FIX 2 (durable password rotation blocking leaked/weak/reused passwords). All backend suites green (71/71 pytest, 66/66 audit_dynamic.py over HTTPS), yarn typecheck clean. All 6 persisted browser checks pass after fixing two test-authored defects discovered during rerun (wrong POS route '/pos' instead of '/vender' in pos-category-filter-and-sale.mjs; stale assumption that a persistent OPERADOR fixture user still existed in seller-sale-and-return.mjs / seller-ui-restrictions.mjs — fixture accounts under @teste-saas.com are swept between runs by design, so both checks now idempotently (re)create their OPERADOR dependency via the admin API before logging in, matching fixture-isolation discipline).

checks.name: pytest-tests-suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && pytest -q -> '71 passed in 17.24s' (tests/test_tenant_isolation.py, test_tscheck_backup_run_and_download.py, test_tscheck_cors_and_status.py, test_tscheck_cron_backup_webhook.py, test_tscheck_login_throttle.py, test_tscheck_operator_write_blocked.py, test_tscheck_password_rotation.py, test_tscheck_platform_audit_trail.py, test_tscheck_reset_password_throttle.py, test_tscheck_session_token_hashed.py, test_tscheck_signup_throttle.py)

checks.criterion: Tenant isolation and role permissions still hold after the auth/session refactor
checks.name: audit_dynamic-script
checks.evidence: python audit_dynamic.py https://vendas-estoque-12.preview.emergentagent.com -> 'TOTAL: 66 testes . 66 passaram . 0 falharam'. Covers cross-company IDOR 404s, OPERADOR 403 on writes, company roles 403 on /platform/*, owner 403 on company routes, suspended-org session kill, anonymous 401s, no-secrets-in-responses. Note: must run against the HTTPS public URL (not plain http://localhost:8001) because the session cookie is Secure and httpx's cookie jar silently drops Secure cookies sent over http, which produced spurious 401s on the first attempt against localhost -- re-run over HTTPS resolved it (classified flaky/environmental, not an app bug).

checks.name: login-welcome-toast
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check against https://vendas-estoque-12.preview.emergentagent.com: login submitted, post-login route rendered a [data-sonner-toast] with 'Bem-vindo, ...' -- toast fix (Toaster now mounted once in main.tsx) confirmed unchanged.

checks.name: platform-backup-generates-and-logs
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: /plataforma loaded with KPIs, backup run produced a new row in the backups list, and the action appears in the audit-log card -- unchanged.

checks.criterion: Frontend defensive fixes on POS: catalogue loads, category filter works, sale completes with receipt
checks.name: pos-category-filter-and-sale
checks.evidence: FIXED a test-authored bug during this run: the check navigated to the non-existent route '/pos' (the SPA's POS route is '/vender' per App.tsx), which fell through to the catch-all route and silently rendered the dashboard instead of failing loudly -- corrected page.goto target to '/vender'. After the fix: signup->owner-approve->login flow works, two fixture products created, catalogue shows both, category filter 'Bebidas' hides the other product, switching back to 'Todas' and finalizing a sale shows the receipt modal. No app-code change was needed; this was purely a test-script defect.

checks.criterion: Seller (OPERADOR) can log in, see dashboard/catalogue, register a sale at POS and create a return
checks.name: seller-sale-and-return
checks.evidence: FIXED a test-authored bug: the check assumed a persistent OPERADOR fixture (tscheck.operador.seller@teste-saas.com) created in a prior session, but @teste-saas.com fixture accounts are swept between runs by design and the account no longer existed (curl POST /api/auth/login -> 401 'E-mail ou senha incorretos'). Updated the check to log in as COMPANY_ADMIN first and idempotently POST /api/users for the OPERADOR fixture (tolerating 409 Conflict on rerun) before exercising the seller flow. After the fix: OPERADOR login, dashboard+catalogue render, POS sale finalized with receipt, return created from the returnable-sales table -- all pass.

checks.criterion: Seller (OPERADOR) is blocked from management actions in the UI and on the server
checks.name: seller-ui-restrictions
checks.evidence: Same fixture-recreation fix applied as seller-sale-and-return. After the fix: nav-admin/nav-company absent, /produtos shows no create/edit/delete controls and the 'somente leitura' label, /estoque shows no stock-in/adjustment buttons for OPERADOR.
